components.title: Chat Demo
components.description: A reusable platform-aware chat preview with pixel-accurate bubbles, headers and composers for iMessage, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord and Telegram.

variants.name: iMessage
variants.description: Light, white background, no header chrome. Outgoing bubbles use the canonical iMessage vertical gradient (#309BFE → #027BFF). The tail silhouette is rendered with a CSS clip-path so it composites cleanly on any backgroun

props.description: Which platform's chrome and bubbles to render.

Header subtitle (e.g. `online`, `42 members`).
URL for the conversation avatar (iMessage / WhatsApp / Telegram).
Toggle the bottom composer row.
Force light/dark theme. Discord defaults to dark.
Extra classes for the outer wrapper.

components.title: Footer Glow
components.description: A glowing footer backdrop with an interactive halftone wordmark.

variants.name: With a bottom bar over the glow
variants.description: Anything passed as children renders over the glow, below the wordmark — a status badge, social links, copyright.

variants.name: Standalone wordmark
variants.description: The halftone wordmark ships as its own component if you only want the dot-grid lockup without the glow.
